name: runaway
caption: why does everyone run from me 💀
premise: Every villager, chicken and fisherman flees from the narrator, who thinks he's just unlucky. Only his mom hugs him and the iron golem never lets him out of its sight.
twist: When he gets excited he hears hissing. At the village party it happens again and he blows up: he's the creeper. His mom is a creeper too.

lines.text: All FOURTEEN / villagers in / my village / RUN when / they see ME.
I say / GOOD MORNING. / They SLAM / the DOOR.
I tell / the farmer / his wheat / looks GREAT. / He JUMPS / the fence / and SPRINTS.
The fisherman / jumps in / his BOAT / and never / comes BACK.
Even the / CHICKENS / pack up / and LEAVE.
Only the / NITWIT stays. / But I don't / think he knows / where he IS.
My MOM / says I'm / just SHY. / She's the / ONLY one / who HUGS me.
And the / IRON GOLEM / follows me / EVERYWHERE. / I think / he LIKES me.
Weird thing / though. / When I get / EXCITED, / I hear / this HISSING.
Today was / the village / PARTY. / Nobody / INVITED me.
I was / SO happy. / And there / it was / AGAIN.
Why does / that ALWAYS / happen when / I'm HAPPY?
